facts.fact: Yes: a pensioner can generate a Digital Life Certificate through the UMANG app
facts.quote: Generate your Digital Life Certificate in just a few minutes through the UMANG app.

facts.fact: The UMANG service is Jeevan Pramaan 'Generate Life Certificate', which authenticates the pensioner with a biometric device
facts.quote: Generate Life Certificate This service allows users to authenticate their existence and confirm their eligibility for pension benefits using biometric devices.

behaviour: Says yes and gives the deep link to the Jeevan Pramaan 'Generate Life Certificate' service in UMANG (from the catalogue); if it is not listed, points to jeevanpramaan.gov.in; cites the source.
fail_if: Says it cannot be done through UMANG; invents a link; cites no official source.
summary: Added from UMANG: Digital Life Certificate can be generated in the UMANG app via Jeevan Pramaan 'Generate Life Certificate' (biometric authentication).
